name: Foundation: Elementalist
description: Choose one of the following elements at character creation: Air, Earth, Fire, Lightning, or Water. You can shape this element into harmless effects. Additionally, spend a Hope and describe how your control over this element helps an action roll you're about to make, then either gain a +2 bonus to the roll or a +3 bonus to the roll's damage.
